ctx.x: Well Phoebe, you’ve had quite a list of friends and compatriots. And I’m just wondering if you want to share any thoughts about some of them. I just finished reading a book about Peggy Lee and she seemed to be a person who was never quite happy with what she was accomplishing in music, or am I misreading that?

Well of course I helped Peter Richmond with that book because he knew that I worked with Peggy. And her daughter said that I knew Peggy better than she knew her own mother, because I traveled with her and lived with her from time to time. I think writers © Fillius Jazz Archive -13-

in order to make a book sensational or a little more commercial they go into extremes. For example the documentary that they did on Ella Fitzgerald to show her as a very unhappy woman. Ella was not an unhappy woman. And Peggy Lee, she was a human being so there were times in her life where she was depressed or she was lonely, she had a bad romance or something.
